decisions.reason: After two years with no visible traction and weak fit to the firm's maritime strategy, the option value of keeping this distant recruitment service open now looks lower than redeploying resources to core and more related growth areas.

This service remains close to the firm's crewing capabilities and maritime customer base, so even without strong published results the cost of keeping the option open is likely modest relative to its strategic fit.

The new maritime education programme has shown early partner adoption and reinforces the firm's training network and workforce pipeline, so uncertainty is resolving positively and supports continued commitment.

The compliance service has already demonstrated execution for all in-scope vessels by a regulatory deadline, making it a highly credible, core-adjacent offering in a market with persistent compliance demand.

The emissions dashboard fits the firm's digitalisation path and is integrated into existing ship management software, so it is a strategically valuable complement to compliance services even though it is still at an early stage.

The emissions cost simulation tool is an early but well-aligned digital option that complements the firm's compliance offering and should be retained while customer usage and monetisation become clearer.
